title: Jubilant Juicy Venezuelan Split Peas Pilaf
description: A crowd-pleasing Venezuelan dish featuring split peas, this pilaf is salty, bouncy, and low-sodium-friendly, making it a great option for a variety of diets. It is a cure for any meal
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute
Add the split peas, salt, black pepper, and cumin, and stir to combine
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
